lines: Workspace admins decide how AI sessions behave for everyone, in the workspace settings, under Windmill AI.
Custom system prompts add your team's rules to every session: the libraries to use, the folders to write in, the channels to post to.
Backups keep sessions in the workspace storage, encrypted. Retention deletes them after the number of days you choose.
Hide AI sessions removes them, and every AI button, for all members. AI steps in flows keep working.
